releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.description:
## What's changed

- Let large notebooks open beyond benchmark targets and add privacy-safe
  performance diagnostics and retry guidance.
- Improve mobile and desktop Cloud browsing with safe-area-aware layouts,
  animated transitions, and loading feedback.
- Suspend inactive readers, refine notebook controls, and add desktop toolbar
  zoom actions while preserving mobile gestures.
- Restore complete embedded fonts so Markdown PDFs render correctly in
  Supernote Partner and other PDF viewers.

releases.description:
First stable release of Supernote Cloud Sync for Obsidian.

Highlights:
- Mirror Supernote Cloud folders into an Obsidian vault.
- Read, page through, zoom, and embed Supernote notebooks.
- Export notes and send files back to Supernote.
- Use paired-folder, transcription, and automation workflows.

Requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or later.

releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.description:
First public beta of Supernote Cloud Sync for Obsidian.

Highlights:
- Mirror Supernote Cloud folders into an Obsidian vault.
- Read, page through, zoom, and embed Supernote notebooks.
- Export notes, send files to Supernote, and use paired-folder workflows.
- Optional transcription and automation workflows.

Beta notes:
- Install and update through BRAT using this repository.
- Windows command and agent integrations remain experimental pending volunteer validation.
- For the eventual 1.0.0 transition, update through BRAT or remove the beta channel before installing the final release.
